title: Tangent: PM daily capture and pre-launch edit log
content:
Morning capture (quick):
- Coffee, 2x standups, 1:1 with Maya at 11:15 (agenda below).
- High priority: finalize PRD edits for rate-limit UX (need legal ack for new wording).
- Quick wins: tighten launch checklist verbiage so SRE can run preflight without ambiguity.

PRD edits (what I did / what remains):
- Section: Rate limiting behavior (lines 120-158) — simplified sentence structure, added concrete examples: "100 r/s path vs 10 r/s admin". TODO: ask legal if we can use the example customer name.
- Added rollout notes for canary (page 4) — explicit rollback triggers (5% error spike OR 50% higher latency for 3 minutes). Need ops signoff (Luis).
- Metrics table: swapped column order (latency first, then error, then cost). Add k/v cache expected hit rate baseline (ops to provide).
- Outstanding wording question: "private deployments" paragraph currently reads like an SLA promise. Change to "supported by" rather than "guaranteed by". Action: follow up with Legal (Maya) and Security (cc: alex.chang).

Stakeholder follow-ups (fire list):
- @luis: confirm canary rollback env variables — pinged in Slack, waiting. Jira INF-2345 assigned to you.
- @maya: copy-edit and legal review on PRD page 2. If no reply by EOD Thu, escalate to contracts.
- SRE: need preflight script (checklist step 6) — ask for sample runbook; consider adding a dry-run toggle.
- Sales: send one-pager + FAQ by Friday (key Qs: regional availability, dedicated capacity timing, pricing bands).

Launch checklist (rough, for my eyes):
- [ ] Finalize PRD (text + table) — deadline: 2026-03-12 (in progress).
- [ ] Legal signoff on product wording (Maya).
- [ ] Ops verification: canary + rollback test performed in staging (Luis).
- [ ] Console UX copy update: streaming label, function call examples (I will ping design).
- [ ] Billing: confirm unit pricing display for embeddings vs generation.
- [ ] KMS integration doc updated for Private (security to confirm).
- [ ] Release notes draft + key customer notice (prepare 1 pager).
- [ ] Post-launch monitoring dashboard: token cost per route, 95p latency, error budget burn.

Notes from 1:1 with Maya (11:15):
- Keep PRD neutral on SLA language. Legal prefers "aims to" vs "will" in most consumer-facing bullets.
- She suggested an appendix with acceptable security controls instead of long paragraphs in main doc. Good.
- Follow-up: ask for contract clause examples for dedicated vs private.

Quick timeline (today -> next 72h):
- Today (3/12): finish PRD copy, ping ops, draft release note.
- 3/13: ops run canary, runbook drafted.
- 3/14: stakeholder review; freeze copy at noon for release notes.

Risks / open questions (short):
- If KV cache hit assumptions are wrong we could see 2-3x token costs on early traffic. Need ops simulation.
- Ambiguous phrasing around "private deployments" and data residency; legal needs to confirm.
- Console UX for function/tool calling: edge cases not in PRD (how we render tool errors).

Random scratch thoughts (keep short):
- Could we add a tiny probe endpoint for latency profiling right after gateway? Low overhead, helpful.
- Consider including a short FAQ blurb about model fallbacks (which variant used and why).

Slack/TODO quick hits: (copy after triage)
- /msg @luis quick: can you run rollback test in staging today? Add results to INF-2345.
- @maya: ping for legal review on wording in PRD page 2.
- @design: small ask: rename streaming toggle to "stream responses"? prefer shorter label.

End-of-day capture (if time):
- Assemble release note bullet list.
- Drop PRD into confluence as page draft and share link in #product-launch.

Notes to self: keep language concrete, always show the failure modes. When in doubt, add an explicit fallback clause.

---
Recent edits: bullets cleaned, added rollback triggers, moved metrics table.
Next immediate step: squeeze in legal follow-up before 5pm PST.

(footnote) quick links: INF-2345 (ops canary), INF-2401 (billing display), PR #987 (console copy).
